subject: Pen test artifact ownership + curation for ACME engagement
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:07:00 -0800
Subject: Pen test artifact request from RedwoodSec (ACME) -- what we can provide

Karthik / Marissa / Grace,

RedwoodSec sent a formal request (attached) asking for the following artifact set for ACME's upcoming pen test validation:
- KV cache logs (slice: 2026-11-20 -> 2026-11-28)
- Ingress/egress pcap for the test window
- AuthZ audit export (CSV) for service accounts used by ACME
- High-level attack surface notes (one-pager)

They asked for deliverables by EOD Wednesday (2026-12-02). Can each of you confirm ownership for the artifacts you can produce and an ETA? If something requires engineering access or production export approvals, call that out — we need to route approvals before tomorrow's deadline.

I attached their request PDF (acme-pt-req-20261129.pdf).

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: acme-pt-req-20261129.pdf (application/pdf, 98KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test artifact request from RedwoodSec (ACME) -- what we can provide

Thanks Monica — quick ownership notes and asks from my side: 
- Marissa: can you confirm where KV/cache logs live (S3 prefix or internal retention service) and whether we can export the 9-day slice as a tar? If yes, can you produce a downloadable bundle and checksum?
- Grace: can you run an authz audit export for service-account events between 11/20 and 11/28. CSV format preferred. Watch for PII — scrub display names per compliance guidance.
- I will coordinate the pcap export but need a signed export approval from CS/legal because these contain external IPs. Monica, can you escalate to CS for a short approval?

ETA: aim to have artifacts staged for review by EOD Tue 2026-12-01 so Monica can do one pass before we share with RedwoodSec. If any blocker, call it out ASAP.

Karthik
Sr. Engineering Manager, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test artifact request from RedwoodSec (ACME) -- what we can provide

Karthik / team,

I can produce KV/cache logs. Notes:
- Logs live in s3://rw-prod-logs/kv-ops/2026-11/*. I will scope and create a tar.gz filtered by the requested date range.
- Expect a ~1.2GB bundle; will provide SHA256 checksum.
- I need temporary elevated S3 read for the export job (I opened an infra ticket #INF-8873).

Plan: export job runs tonight (11/30) and upload to a secure review Drive link. ETA for upload + checksum: Tue 12/01 16:00 PST.

Attachments: redwood-kv-logs-export-20261129.tar.gz (attachment stub)

-Marissa
Lead Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 08:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test artifact request from RedwoodSec (ACME) -- what we can provide

Karthik / team,

AuthZ export done: attached CSV contains service-account events for the window. Scrubbed human-readable names, retained account ids. File: authz-audit-20261128.csv (attached).

Notes:
- I removed full user display names per compliance, kept IDs + timestamps + action types.
- If RedwoodSec needs diffs by endpoint, we'll need to run additional parsing (estimate 2 hours).

Uploading the CSV to the secure Drive link now.

-Grace
Security Engineer
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: authz-audit-20261128.csv (text/csv, 210KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 01 Dec 2026 17:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pen test artifact request from RedwoodSec (ACME) -- what we can provide

Team — great progress. Monica, CS/legal approval for pcap export came through at 16:30 (ticket: LEG-3049). I kicked off the pcap extraction (network-pcap-20261128.pcap). Marissa: once the pcap is available, please add it to the review Drive and include a short README (pcap fields, anonymization note).

Action items for me: merge the artifacts into a single review package, create README and a short attack-surface one-pager. I will draft the one-pager and share it for Monica's sign-off by morning.

ETA: final review package to Monica: Wed 12/02 09:00 PST. Monica, once you approve, can you coordinate the external handoff to RedwoodSec and Acme? We should avoid sending raw pcaps to external without a secure transfer link.

Karthik

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: RedwoodSec Labs <sec-team@redwoodsec.io>, Acme Corp Security <security@acme.example>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2026 15:44:00 -0800
Subject: ACME pen test — artifact bundle ready for review (secure link)

Hi Sam / ACME team,

Thanks for the patience. We prepared the artifact bundle for your review. Package includes:
- KV/cache logs (redwood-kv-logs-export-20261129.tar.gz)
- Network capture (network-pcap-20261128.pcap) — redacted for PII, provided via expiring secure link
- AuthZ audit export (authz-audit-20261128.csv)
- A short attack-surface summary (attack-surface-acme-20261202.md)

Download link (expires in 7 days): https://secure-transfer.redwood.ai/s/ACME-pt-2026 (access controlled).

Please acknowledge receipt and flag any follow-up artifacts or parsing you need. Per our SLA we can run endpoint-level diffs or extended logs for an additional 4 hours of engineering time — let us know if you want us to proceed.

Internal note: Marissa/Grace/Karthik — thanks for the fast turnaround. Marking this thread as the official handoff. If RedwoodSec requests raw Pcap delivery, we'll use the signed secure transfer and log access.

Best,
Monica
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: redwood-kv-logs-export-20261129.tar.gz (application/gzip), network-pcap-20261128.pcap (application/vnd.tcpdump.pcap), authz-audit-20261128.csv (text/csv)
